outputs: Augmented texts generated for active learning
Semantically similar texts through data augmentation using Semi-supervised Variational AutoEncoder (S-VAE) with masked attention learning and character variation graph-enhanced augmentation

changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Paraphrase Generation' as it's not the focus - the paper is about data augmentation for active learning. Consolidated duplicate model names and removed redundant descriptions. Kept the core NLG task as text generation for data augmentation.
No automatic metrics for NLG evaluation are mentioned in the paper. The evaluation focuses on classification performance of the spam detection system, not quality of generated texts.
No LLMs are used as judges in this paper. The paper predates widespread use of LLM-as-judge methodology.
No human evaluation of generated outputs is conducted. The paper only mentions human annotation for rationale labeling during active learning, not evaluation of generated text quality.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on spam detection using active learning with text generation for data augmentation. While it generates text, the primary evaluation is on classification performance rather than NLG quality. The extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed consolidation of duplicate model names and removal of 'Paraphrase Generation' which was not the paper's focus.
